candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST /v1/orders 503s and gateway checkout 502s after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or DB logs; pool exhaustion inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, DependencyUnavailable, propagating as order 503 and gateway 502 at ~2s. Gateway logs confirm transport errors to order; metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency.
